battle.name: 郾城之戰
battle.brief: 紹興十年（1140）十月，完顏宗弼率大軍自河南南下，直抵汴蔡之間的郾城。劉錡自鄂州起兵，經池州、廬州、定遠、濠州北行，抵郾城結營，以長槍大盾拒馬、弓弩齊射，待金軍攻勢受挫乘隙出擊，金軍北退。戰場在今河南漯河；卡面那件拜占庭燃燒劑彼時仍屬地中海海軍。

kit.name: 希臘火
kit.history: 配在銅管裡的燃燒劑。配方是帝國的機密，配方和船一起沉了。

countries: 交戰的兩方是南宋與金國。金方在紹興十年（1140）由熙宗完顏亶在位時下令南侵，主力統帥是河南統軍完顏宗弼，即人稱兀朮的左副元帥，以騎軍為主，裹著大批糧械自開封、蔡州一線南下，另有一路偏師自兩淮策應；金廷樞密院掌軍令，汴京留守司與各路統軍司分領兵權，攻城與水軍各有專司。宋方是南宋朝廷，高宗趙構在位，紹興九年（1139）金熙宗即位後宋金曾重訂和議，宋以稱臣、年貢銀絹各二十五萬、割唐鄧二州為代價，換取淮水為界；紹興十年金人毀約再攻，淮南西路由淮南西路招撫使、提領淮南兵馬劉錡節制，兵員來自湖北副都統所部與沿江、兩淮各鎮戍軍，樞密院與中書門下發軍令，前線則由劉錡統一指揮池州、舒城、廬州、定遠、濠州一線的城守與援軍；同一體系裡還有屯兵襄陽的岳家軍，岳飛已在同年七月於郾城一線擊敗金軍。河南汝州、蔡州與開封在金人手中，郾城正卡在汴、蔡之間的南北孔道上，是雙方必爭之地。
countriesEn: The two sides in this battle were Southern Song and the Jin empire. On the Jin side the order to invade the south was issued in 1140 while the Jurchen emperor Xizong, Wanyan Dan, was still on the throne; the commander of the main force was Wanyan Zongbi, better known as Wusu, who as Left Deputy Marshal held the armies of Henan. His host was mounted in the main, dragging a great deal of food and materiel down the line from Kaifeng and Caizhou, while another column was sent forward from the Two Huai to support him. In the Jin state the Privy Council issued the orders, the capital garrison and the several regional armies divided the command, and siege work and river warfare each had their own specialists. On the Song side was the Southern Song court under Gaozong Zhao Gou. In 1139, after the accession of the Jin emperor Xizong, Song and Jin had renewed the peace settlement: Song was to call itself a vassal, to pay an annual tribute of 250,000 in silver and 250,000 in silk, and to cede the circuits of Tang and Deng, in exchange for a frontier on the Huai River. When the Jin broke that agreement in 1140 and attacked again, the defence of the western Huai was given to Liu Qi, Pacification Commissioner of western Huainan and holder of the command of the Huainan forces; his men came from the deputy command of Hubei together with the garrison of the riverbank stations and of the Two Huai forts. The Privy Council and the Secretariat passed the orders downward, but on the front the command was Liu Qi's alone, covering the walled towns and the reinforcing columns along Chizhou, Shucheng, Luzhou, Dingyuan and Haozhou. The same order of battle also contained Yue Fei's army at Xiangyang, and Yue had already beaten the Jin in the same county in the seventh month of that year. Ruzhou, Caizhou and Kaifeng lay in Jin hands, and Yancheng sat exactly on the north-south artery between Bian and Cai, a stretch of road neither side could afford to lose.
people: 劉錡（1098—1163），字信叔，撫州臨川人，是此戰真正的主帥。他早年入趙鼎幕府，秦檜對他十分忌憚，一度借故貶謫嶺南，幾乎斷送性命；紹興年間他先後任湖北副都統、淮南西路招撫使，掌管江淮之間的防務。紹興十年秋，金人南侵的消息傳到江上，他不急著南下迎敵，也不在沿線各城逐個固守，而是自鄂州起兵北上，率眾穿過池州、舒城、廬州、定遠、濠州，把行軍拉成一條直插豫東的長線；他的判斷是金人遠來求戰，我方以逸待勞，只要不與之浪戰、只守營壘，其鋒自折。軍中諸將多主張避戰，他力主不退，終於在郾城把金軍打退。金方統帥完顏宗弼（兀朮）率大軍自河南而下，兵雖眾而未能越淮；他與完顏亮之間積不相能，完顏亮於紹興十年九月弒熙宗自立，十月廢後宮、十一月大赦，隨後把矛頭轉向淮南。岳飛與劉錡是同年並用的兩支力量，卻不屬同一指揮系統，各打各的；同樣的將帥分立，後來成了南宋內部難以調和的裂痕。
peopleEn: Liu Qi (1098-1163), courtesy name Xinshu, of Linchuan in Fuzhou prefecture, was the real commander of this campaign. Early in his career he served in the staff of Zhao Ding, and Qin Hui disliked him sharply enough to have him demoted to Lingnan on a pretext, very nearly ending his life; through the Shaoxing years he held in turn the deputy command of Hubei and the office of Pacification Commissioner of western Huainan, and with it the defence of the country between the Yangtze and the Huai. In the autumn of 1140, when word of the Jin invasion reached the river, he did not hurry south to meet them and did not try to hold one small town after another along the route. Instead he marched north out of Ezhou with the whole force, through Chizhou, Shucheng, Luzhou, Dingyuan and Haozhou, stretching the march into a single long line aimed at eastern Henan. His reasoning was that the Jin had come a long way in order to give battle, so if his own army stayed at ease behind its entrenchments and refused to be drawn into a running fight, the enemy would spend its own edge. Many of his officers wanted to avoid the battle; he refused to yield ground, and in the end he drove the Jin back at Yancheng. The Jin commander Wanyan Zongbi (Wusu) came down from Henan with a host that was numerous but never crossed the Huai; he was on bad terms with Wanyan Liang, who murdered the Xizong emperor in the ninth month of 1140, deposed the palace women in the tenth month and proclaimed an amnesty in the eleventh, and then turned his attention to the Huai. Yue Fei and Liu Qi were two armies employed in the same year, yet they did not belong to a single command system and fought their own separate actions; division of that kind among the generals later became a fissure inside the Southern Song that was never healed.
kits: 卡面這件兵器是拜占庭帝國的燃燒劑，公元六七〇年前後由赫利奧波利斯的工匠卡利尼科斯改良配方：燃燒劑裝在銅管之中，由專門的戰船與專門的射手操作，噴出時伴著轟響與濃煙，落在水面仍能燃燒，對手只能以沙、醋或陳尿滅火。它是徹底的海軍武器，靠的是一套嚴格分權的體系——調製藥劑、加熱加壓的爐具、銅管的射法與司操作的射手彼此不通姓名，敵人即使繳獲銅管與殘料也無從複製。帝國先後在六二六年、七一七至七一八年的君士坦丁堡保衛戰用過它，此後又用於九四一年與一〇四三年抗羅斯襲擊，十二世紀仍有記載，一二〇三年第四次十字軍圍城時火船在金角灣焚毀敵艦，配方從此失傳。郾城的營壘裡沒有這種東西。真正可能沾上火字的是另一套中國兵器：《武經總要》卷十一的攻堅篇載有猛火油櫃，以銅管盛膏油、臨時點火噴出，用來燒毀敵人的攻城器械與舟船；同時代還有火藥箭、陶製的爆炸物震天雷，以及金人攻開封時用過的霹靂砲。希臘火與猛火油櫃同屬把燃燒劑射出去的思路，但一者以海戰為舞台、配方由帝國獨占，一者是北宋軍器譜裡的攻堅條目，各成體系。真正出現在郾城並決定勝負的，是長桿槍、大盾、神臂弓、步弩與披甲騎兵。
kitsEn: The weapon on the card is the incendiary of the Byzantine empire, whose formula was improved around 670 by an artificer from Heliopolis named Kallinikos. The burning mixture was carried in copper tubes, worked from purpose-built warships and by trained operators; when it was spat out it came with a roar and heavy smoke, it burned on the surface of water, and it could be smothered only with sand, vinegar or stale urine. It was a naval weapon in every sense, and it rested on an entire system of strictly compartmented knowledge: the compounding of the mixture, the heating and pressurising apparatus, the way the tube was worked and the men who served it each knew only their own part, so an enemy who captured tubes and residue could never copy the whole. The empire used it in the defence of Constantinople in 626 and again in 717 and 718, and later against the Rus raids of 941 and 1043; it was still recorded in the twelfth century, and when the Fourth Crusade besieged Constantinople in 1203 the fireships burned the enemy fleet in the Golden Horn, after which the formula was lost for good. Nothing of the sort stood in the camp at Yancheng. The only things there that came near the word fire belonged to a different Chinese arm: the Wujing Zongyao compiled in the Northern Song lists, in the eleventh volume on siege works, a cabinet of fierce fire oil, which held grease in a copper tube and was lit at the moment of use so as to spray burning liquid at the enemy's siege engines and boats; the same age also knew gunpowder arrows, the ceramic explosive known as the thundering heaven thunder, and the thunder crash bomb the Jin had used at Kaifeng. Greek fire and the cabinet of fire oil share the idea of throwing a burning substance at the enemy, but one was a naval weapon whose formula a single empire monopolised, the other an entry in a Northern Song manual of siege instruments; they are separate systems. What actually stood at Yancheng, and decided the day, were the long-shafted spear, the large shield, the divine arm crossbow, the foot crossbow and the armoured cavalry.
tactics: 劉錡的野戰打法，可以從他一路上應付金騎的幾次接觸裡看出來。第一層是行軍與補給：他自鄂州出發前，先在沿途州縣儲糧、修整城寨，把淮南各軍的存糧與船隻編入自己的輜重，北上每一站都有現成的倉廩可依，這才使他敢遠離長江而深入豫東。第二層是拒騎：金人的重甲騎兵衝鋒，宋軍不與之比馬速，而以長桿槍與大盾結成拒馬，長槍在前抵住衝撞，弓弩手在盾陣之後分層齊射，箭矢自上方壓住騎兵的衝鋒路徑，逼得騎兵在陣前失速、無法展開；金騎一旦衝不穿盾陣，銳氣一泄，宋軍的精騎便由兩翼突出反擊，收繳對方的馬匹與甲械。第三層是郾城一線的陣地作戰：劉錡擇地立寨，先以輕騎游騎反覆偵察金軍的營壘布置，看出其兵多而陣列不整之後仍不主動出擊，只令軍士安營修牆、蓄養氣力，逼金人先來攻；待金軍攻至營前、隊形被長槍與弩箭攪亂，他才以中軍主力乘隙突出，合圍截斷金軍退路。金軍的應對則是以騎軍反覆衝擊宋軍營寨，想在弩箭的消耗中撕開缺口，若連攻不克、士卒疲憊，便收攏隊形退走。雙方的成敗因此都落在三點上：誰的陣列更整、誰的弓弩更密、誰的補給線更短。十月的豫東秋高氣爽，地面乾燥利於騎兵往來衝殺，汝水、漯水沿岸的狹窄地形又限制了金騎的數量優勢。
tacticsEn: The way Liu Qi fought in the open can be read off the several encounters with the Jin horse along his advance. The first layer was marching and supply: before he left Ezhou he had grain stored and the towns repaired along the route, and the grain and the boats of the Huainan armies were folded into his own train, so that every stage of the northward march had a warehouse already waiting for him; that is what allowed him to leave the Yangtze and strike deep into eastern Henan. The second layer was the refusal of cavalry. When the Jin heavy horse charged, the Song did not try to outrun them. Long-shafted spears and large shields were locked together into a fence of spears, the spears taking the impact in front, while the crossbowmen behind the shield line fired in successive ranks, their bolts coming down from above onto the path of the charge and spoiling the horses' speed before they could spread. Once the Jin horse failed to break the fence its edge was spent, and Song cavalry struck out from both wings and took the enemy's horses and armour. The third layer was positional fighting at Yancheng. Liu chose his ground and raised a camp; he sent light horse and patrols to observe the Jin encampment again and again, and even after seeing that the enemy was numerous but badly ordered he did not attack first. He had the men dig in, repair the camp walls and husband their strength, forcing the Jin to come to him; only when the attackers had reached the camp and their formation had been thrown into confusion by spear and bolt did he drive the main body of his centre out through the gap and close around the Jin retreat. The Jin answer was to hammer the Song camp with horse, hoping to tear a hole while the bolts wore the defenders down, and when the assault failed and the men were exhausted they drew their ranks together and withdrew. The outcome on both sides therefore turned on three things: whose order was tighter, whose bows and crossbows were denser, and whose supply line was shorter. The tenth month in eastern Henan is clear and dry, ground that suits horse manoeuvre, while the narrow country along the Ru and Luo waters limits the numerical advantage of the Jin horse.
data: 可核對的數字大致如下。時間上，此役在紹興十年十月，即公元1140年11月上旬至12月上旬之間；同一縣城的另一場勝仗在同年七月，是岳飛部與金軍的郾城大捷。兵力方面，金軍南下的總數史籍多稱十萬或十餘萬，這是統帥與史家的概數，實際到陣的騎兵當在數萬之譜；劉錡所部為數萬之眾，由湖北副都統本部與淮南、沿江各鎮部隊匯合而成，確數各家記載不一，宋人自己的記述也只用數萬人一類的概數。距離上，郾城在今河南省漯河市郾城區一帶，控汴、蔡之間的南北孔道，距汴京約一百五十公里，距蔡州約九十公里；劉錡自鄂州（今武漢）出發，經池州、舒城、廬州、定遠、濠州，迂迴行程約五百公里，用了一個多月才抵郾城。射程方面，《宋史·兵志》記神臂弓臂長三尺二寸、矢長三尺五寸、射程三百四十步，約合五百米上下，是宋軍壓制騎兵的主要手段。時機上還有一層巧合：紹興十年九月金熙宗完顏亶在宮中為完顏亮所弒，完顏亮自立為海陵王，同年十月廢後宮、十一月大赦，郾城之戰正好打在這場宮變的風頭之下。希臘火那一組數字則屬另一個世界：配方在七世紀末定型，十二世紀仍在使用，十三世紀初隨君士坦丁堡的陷落而徹底失傳。
dataEn: The figures that can be checked run roughly as follows. In time, the battle belongs to the tenth month of 1140, that is the first days of November to the first days of December on the western calendar; the other victory in the same county came in the seventh month of the same year, the Yancheng victory won by Yue Fei's men. In strength, the sources describe the Jin invading force as one hundred thousand or more; those are the commander's own figures and the historians' round numbers, and the horse actually present on the field must have been in the tens of thousands at most. Liu Qi had a force of several tens of thousands, drawn from the deputy command of Hubei together with the garrisons of Huainan and of the riverbank stations; the exact number is recorded differently from source to source, and the Song themselves use only round figures of the kind 'several tens of thousands'. In distance, Yancheng lies in the Yancheng district of Luohe in modern Henan province, holding the north-south road between Bian and Cai, roughly a hundred and fifty kilometres from Kaifeng and about ninety from Caizhou; Liu Qi set out from Ezhou, present-day Wuhan, by way of Chizhou, Shucheng, Luzhou, Dingyuan and Haozhou, a circuit of some five hundred kilometres that took him more than a month to complete. In range, the History of Song records for the divine arm crossbow a bow of three feet two inches, an arrow of three feet five inches and a range of three hundred and forty paces, some five hundred metres, which made it the principal Song weapon for checking cavalry. As to timing there was one coincidence: in the ninth month of 1140 the Jin emperor Xizong, Wanyan Dan, was murdered in the palace by Wanyan Liang, who then took the throne as Prince of Hai Ling; in the tenth month the palace women were deposed and in the eleventh month an amnesty was proclaimed, and the battle of Yancheng was fought under the shadow of that palace coup. The figures belonging to Greek fire belong to another world entirely: the formula was settled by the end of the seventh century, was still in use in the twelfth, and was lost for good when Constantinople fell in the early thirteenth.
cause: 起因是金國在紹興和議之後的第一次毀約。紹興九年，金熙宗完顏亶即位，金宋在淮水流域重訂和議，條件包括宋向金稱臣、歲貢銀絹各二十五萬、割唐鄧二州，南宋廷以秦檜為首的主和派接受了條款，淮南一線的防務隨之鬆弛，張俊所部被解除兵權，許多原在北疆的將領調離或罷黜，邊防空虛。這種局面維持不到一年：紹興十年，完顏亮弒熙宗自立，隨即整頓軍政、召回南線主戰的舊將，完顏宗弼率大軍自河南南下，重新要求宋廷歸還唐鄧並追加條件，戰端再起。對南宋而言還有更切近的壓力：前一年金人新造舟師，屢次窺探兩淮，淮南各鎮守兵普遍不足，糧秣亦不齊備。劉錡正是在這種空虛中受命，他不與金人逐路爭小城，也不急於南下迎敵，而是取最反直覺的做法：北進，把戰場推到敵人背後，把金軍拉成一條長而脆弱的縱隊，再在郾城這個位置上以逸待勞。
causeEn: The cause was the first breach of the peace after the Shaoxing settlement. In 1139, when the Jin emperor Xizong, Wanyan Dan, came to the throne, Jin and Song renewed the treaty along the Huai: Song would call itself a vassal, pay an annual tribute of 250,000 in silver and 250,000 in silk, and cede Tang and Deng; the leading party of peace at the Southern Song court, headed by Qin Hui, accepted those terms, and the defence of the Huai line grew slack accordingly. The army of Zhang Jun was stripped of its command, many generals who had served on the northern frontier were transferred away or dismissed, and the border was left hollow. That condition lasted less than a year. In 1140 Wanyan Liang murdered the emperor, set about reorganising the government and recalled the old hawks of the southern command; Wanyan Zongbi led a great army down from Henan, demanded once more that the Song court return Tang and Deng and added further conditions, and the war began again. For the Southern Song the pressure was closer to hand as well: in the previous year the Jin had built new ships and had probed the Two Huai repeatedly, the garrisons of the Huainan towns were generally under strength, and the grain was not in readiness. Liu Qi was given command in that hollow. He did not fight for one small town after another along the line, nor did he hurry south to meet the enemy; he took the most counter-intuitive course available and marched north, pushing the battlefield behind the enemy, drawing the Jin army out into a long and brittle column, and then waited for them at Yancheng on ground of his own choosing.
impact: 這一戰在當時的直接意義，是宋軍在淮北野戰中第一次明確壓住了金軍的攻勢。紹興年間金人南下多能得手，宋軍往往只能守城而不能野戰，郾城一役卻是以弩陣與槍盾結成的步兵方陣當面吃掉金軍的騎兵衝鋒，並乘勢追擊擴大戰果，對金廷的聲望是一次打擊。政治上的後果卻與戰場結果相反：以秦檜為首的主和派不願看到主戰將領居功，郾城之捷未及論賞，劉錡隨即被調離淮南前線，樞密與中書的掣肘也從未解除；同樣在十月，金國完成宮變，完顏亮以新主之姿整軍，兩年後再傾國南下，仍然無功而返。長期來看，郾城一役留下的教訓是雙向的：對宋廷而言，它說明以步弩制騎可行，卻不足以取代收復失地；對金廷而言，它加速了吸收中原火藥技術、打造攻城砲具與新式武器的腳步，後來金人攻襄陽時在武器上的準備，正是沿這條線走。戰場本身也進入記憶：七月與十月的兩場勝利合稱郾城之捷，在宋金雙方的戰史裡被反覆引用的，是用弩陣正面擋住騎兵的辦法；宋人從此把神臂弓與大盾陣視為守土的重要手段，淮北的城寨體系、屯田與漕運也隨之整頓。
impactEn: The immediate meaning of this battle was that a Song army in the open field north of the Huai for the first time clearly checked a Jin offensive. Through the Shaoxing years the Jin usually had the better of it when they came south, and the Song could hold walled towns but could not fight in the field; at Yancheng a phalanx of crossbow and spear-and-shield foot actually ate the Jin charge, and the pursuit carried the victory further, which was a blow to the standing of the Jin court. The political consequences ran the other way. The party of peace under Qin Hui had no wish to see generals of the war faction rewarded; the victory at Yancheng was never properly rewarded, Liu Qi was moved off the Huai front soon afterwards, and the restraint of the Privy Council and the Secretariat was never lifted. In the same month the Jin court completed its coup, and Wanyan Liang, as a new ruler, put the army in order and came south with everything he had two years later, only to achieve nothing. In the longer run the lesson of Yancheng ran both ways. For the Song court it showed that checking cavalry with foot crossbows was possible, though not enough to take lost ground; for the Jin court it quickened the step in absorbing Chinese gunpowder technique and building siege artillery and new weapons, the preparations that later carried Jin arms against Xiangyang. The battlefield itself entered memory as well: the two victories of the seventh and tenth months together are called the victory of Yancheng, and what both sides' war histories quote from it is the method of meeting the horse with a crossbow line in front. From then on the Song treated the divine arm crossbow and the shield fence as a chief means of holding ground, and the network of forts, the garrison farms and the grain transport of the country north of the Huai were reorganised to match.
result: 十月的郾城，宋軍營寨未被攻破，金軍的攻勢反而在宋軍的弩箭與槍盾前耗盡，隨即收軍北退，宋軍乘勝追擊，奪獲馬匹、甲械與糧秣，記錄稱斬獲甚眾；具體數字歷來記法不一，可信的是宋軍確以數萬之眾擋住了號稱十萬的金軍主力，一場野戰的勝負卻沒有被宋廷充分利用。七月與十月的兩場郾城之捷合在一起，改變了金人南下的節奏：完顏亮在紹興十一年再傾國來攻，卻在兩淮與江上折戟，紹興十二年雙方重訂和議，疆界仍以淮水為界，歲貢條件照舊。劉錡其後被調離前線，數年後病逝；同樣的結局落在岳飛身上，郾城捷後不足兩年，他以莫須有之罪被殺。從軍事史上看，這一戰的結果並非一面倒：宋軍贏了正面交鋒，卻沒有改變和議的格局，也沒有換來北進；金軍雖然受挫，主力尚存，淮河南北的拉鋸仍將延續數十年，直至金亡宋興。
resultEn: At Yancheng in the tenth month the Song camp was not broken; the Jin attack was instead spent against the Song bolts and the spear-and-shield line, and the Jin drew off north. The Song followed up and took horses, armour, weapons and stores, and the records say that many were killed and captured, though the exact figures are given differently from source to source and cannot be pinned down. What can be said is that an army of several tens of thousands did stand in the way of a Jin host called a hundred thousand. The two victories at Yancheng, in the seventh and the tenth months, together changed the rhythm of the Jin offensives: when Wanyan Liang came south once more with everything he had in 1141 he was checked in the Two Huai and on the river, and in 1142 the two states renewed the peace, the frontier still running along the Huai and the tribute terms unchanged. Liu Qi was then moved away from the front and died of illness some years later; Yue Fei's ending was of another kind, for less than two years after the victory at Yancheng he was put to death on the charge of a crime with no name. Viewed in military history the result is not one-sided: the Song won the open engagement but changed neither the terms of the settlement nor the frontier, and the Jin, though checked, still had its army intact, so the tug of war north and south of the Huai was to run on for decades, until the fall of Jin and the rise of Song.
